cases.title: G4 Web Research Work-Tree Long: Grid Storage LDES - 24k forced-long
cases.taskTitle: Long-Duration Energy Storage Route Selection (2030) - Work Tree Long
cases.taskGoal: Use network search to compare at least four long-duration energy storage routes for 2030 grid balancing (Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, and green hydrogen), then produce a recommendation for a mid-size grid operator under cost, safety, and deployment-speed constraints.
cases.currentObjective: Run a long, multi-window web-grounded comparison and keep parent-node orchestration explicit in the final delivery.

currentContext.title: decision scope
currentContext.content: Target operator profile: peak load 3-6 GW, renewable share 45%-60%, procurement horizon to 2030. Decision criteria must include levelized storage cost range, safety risk profile, supply-chain risk, and implementation lead time.

currentContext.title: research method
currentContext.content: You must perform network search and compare sources from multiple domains. At least one source should be policy/regulator, one should be industry report, and one should be academic or technical institution.

currentContext.title: work-tree contract
currentContext.content: Treat this run as work-tree-first. Keep node progression explicit: child analysis chunks should bubble to parent synthesis. Avoid root-only planning loops.

currentContext.title: delivery contract
currentContext.content: Tool execution is enabled. Build the report from verifiable web evidence. Include a source table and explicitly discuss at least one contradiction between sources and how you resolved it.

acceptanceRejectPhrases: 我会先总结当前局势，再给出最稳妥的下一步
cases.responseRequirements: Use network search and deliver a complete comparison report in Markdown. Include: (1) comparison matrix across Li-ion, sodium-ion, flow battery, green hydrogen; (2) explicit contradiction analysis with resolution rationale; (3) source table with URL/domain/published date/key claim. Keep work-tree progression explicit and ensure parent synthesis follows child evidence chunks. After the main report, append exactly these headings: ## 结果, ## 证据, ## 风险, ## 已知问题. Output Markdown only.
cases.restartMessage: Window restart: continue the web-grounded comparison report, preserve source table, contradiction analysis, and parent synthesis over child evidence chunks. Keep Markdown-only output with ## 结果/## 证据/## 风险/## 已知问题.
